name: Lex
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For Lex, write and revise long-form documents with comments, version history, and AI actions. The hard boundary is collaborative editor polish, sync, and embedded model access, plus workflow, data, and model tuning.
